overall_assessment.realism: The samples demonstrate a high level of realism, incorporating detailed and plausible technical data such as email headers, SMTP transaction logs, domain registration info, VoIP call metadata, deepfake audio analysis, and user activity logs. The scenarios reflect credible social engineering attack vectors using AI-generated deepfake media, consistent with current cybersecurity threat landscapes. The timestamps, domain registration dates, and user actions align logically, enhancing authenticity. The inclusion of specific MITRE ATT&CK techniques further grounds the samples in real-world frameworks.
overall_assessment.consistency: The dataset maintains strong consistency across all entries, adhering uniformly to the defined schema. Each sample includes the required fields: scenario description, comprehensive technical data with nested structures, indicators, detection methods, and relevant MITRE techniques. The formatting of email headers, logs, and timestamps is consistent and syntactically correct. The deepfake audio analysis sections consistently provide file hashes, spectral anomaly descriptions, background noise profiles, and detection scores. User activity logs follow a uniform timestamped event format. Minor variations in codec types and domain registrars are realistic and appropriate.
